info.title: Decision Sandbox
info.description:
**A free synthetic decision API for testing Jev-compatible integrations.**

Decision Sandbox implements the public TypeSafe API contract (`POST /v1/systemone`,
`GET /v1/models`) and returns correctly typed **synthetic** answers. They are
randomly generated: no model runs, and nothing here reproduces Jev or any other
model. Probabilities are not calibrated predictions. Do not use them for real
decisions. This project is independent and not affiliated with TypeSafe.

Point your integration at this base URL instead of `https://api.typesafe.ai`.
An API key is required: use the free key `github-2026` (`Authorization: Bearer github-2026`).

Control the answers with headers (or query parameters):

| Header | Query | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Sandbox-Seed` | `seed` | Same request + same seed = same response |
| `X-Sandbox-Scenario` | `scenario` | Predefined behaviour. See `GET /sandbox/scenarios` |
| `X-Sandbox-Delay-Ms` | `delay_ms` | Adds latency (max 5000 ms) |

Every response carries `X-Sandbox-Synthetic: true`, `X-Request-Id` and, on decisions,
the `X-Sandbox-Seed` that produced it, so any random answer can be replayed.

get.description:
List the model names accepted by `POST /v1/systemone`.

The sandbox accepts any model name; these are listed for discovery.

post.description:
Answer one or more questions about the content supplied in `state`.

Answers are **synthetic**. They are random, or derived from a seed or scenario,
and are not produced by a model.

400.description: Unknown sandbox scenario or invalid seed

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a selection from the requested choices.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The name of the choice with the highest probability.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in the selected choice, from 0 to 1.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Probability of each choice in criteria, keyed by choice name. Values sum to approximately 1.

ChoiceAnswer.title: ChoiceAnswer
ChoiceAnswer.description: The selected choice, confidence, and probabilities for a choice question.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a question that selects one of the choices in criteria.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: What the model should decide when choosing an option.
examples: What is the tone of this message?

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Choice names and descriptions of when each applies. A choice without a description is interpreted by its name alone.

ChoiceQuestion.title: ChoiceQuestion
ChoiceQuestion.description: A question that selects one option from the choices you define.

name.title: Name
name.description: Model name or alias accepted by the request's model field.

release_date.title: Release Date
release_date.description: Model release date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

ModelMetadata.title: ModelMetadata
ModelMetadata.description: A model or model alias available to the caller.

ModelMetadataList.title: ModelMetadataList
ModelMetadataList.description: Models and aliases available to the caller.

noul.title: Noul
noul.description: Probability of a yes answer or a true statement, from 0 to 1.

NoulAnswer.title: NoulAnswer
NoulAnswer.description: The probability of a yes answer or a true statement.

true.title: True
true.description: What counts as a yes answer.

false.title: False
false.description: What counts as a no answer.
examples: The message is a legitimate conversation.

NoulCriteria.title: NoulCriteria
NoulCriteria.description: Criteria defining what counts as a yes or no answer.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a yes/no question or statement.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: The yes/no question or statement to evaluate.

criteria.description: Criteria clarifying what counts as a yes or no answer.

NoulQuestion.title: NoulQuestion
NoulQuestion.description: A yes/no question or statement, answered with the probability of yes or true.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a rating against the requested score levels.

score.title: Score
score.description: Expected score: the probability-weighted average of the rubric levels.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence in the score, from 0 to 1.

legend.title: Legend
legend.description: The requested criteria mapped to their score levels, so you can interpret the score.

probabilities.title: Probabilities
probabilities.description: Probability of each score level, using the same keys as legend.

ScoreAnswer.title: ScoreAnswer
ScoreAnswer.description: An expected score with its rubric, confidence, and score-level probabilities.

type.title: Type
type.description: Identifies a question that rates the content using the levels in criteria.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Ordered descriptions of the score levels. Each description's position determines its score, starting at zero.

ScoreQuestion.title: ScoreQuestion
ScoreQuestion.description: A question that assigns a score using an ordered rubric.

state.title: State
state.description: The content all questions in this request refer to.
examples: I was charged twice. Please help.

model.title: Model
model.description: Name or alias of the model to use. Available names are returned by GET /v1/models.

additionalProperties.description: A question about the supplied content.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: Questions to ask about the content, each with a name you choose. The response uses those names to identify the answers.

SystemOneRequest.title: SystemOneRequest
SystemOneRequest.description: Content and named questions to evaluate together.

model.title: Model
model.description: Name of the model that answered the questions.

additionalProperties.description: An answer whose type matches the corresponding question.

answers.title: Answers
answers.description: Answers keyed by the question names supplied in the request.

SystemOneResponse.title: SystemOneResponse
SystemOneResponse.description: Answers grouped by question name, with the model used and token usage.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Number of billable input tokens used to evaluate the request.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens used to answer the questions.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Token usage for the request. Synthetic estimates in the sandbox.
